original_position: Individual GRCh38 peak intervals are in study-additions-v1/braintf-peaks.json.
outcome: 126 screened protein-occupancy observations overlap the OXTR window, representing 43 targets across 13 contexts. 114 overlap the defined proximal promoter.
limitations: Peak observations across assay contexts, not unique sites or independent donors. The experiments share four postmortem donors across regions. assay_methods: Human candidate enhancer DNA in mouse hypothalamic-cell luciferase assays and mouse reporter experiments.
original_position: OCE7 reported hg38 chr3:8757366–8759184; candidate interval and tested construct boundaries retained separately.
outcome: OCE1, OCE5 and OCE7 enhanced reporter activity in mouse hypothalamic cells. The tested DNA was human. OCE7 also drove reporter activity in mouse olfactory bulb at P28 and P56; adult hypothalamic activity was not detected.
limitations: Reporter activity does not establish a named transcription-factor binding site or causal regulation of native human OXTR. The reported OCE7 candidate interval and the Table 1 luciferase-primer span differ. Reported intervals and primer matches are retained separately, without a precise binding-site overlay.
